review_provenance.selection_note: No IDs replaced or reordered. Two dev annotations corrected after error analysis; not an independent test.

scope.corpus: All 488 document files listed in the pinned source inventory
scope.ingestion_allowlist: inventory.documents[].file; no tests, gold answers, dialogue files or evidence annotations in the index
scope.evaluation_unit: One target user turn with its complete supplied prior dialogue history
scope.generalization_claim: new dialogue targets over a shared known corpus; not unseen-document generalization
scope.population_claim: review-filtered quota sample plus authored capability boundaries; not a natural-distribution estimate
scope.reference_language: Preserve reviewed reference language; score semantic equivalence across languages. Answer should follow the current user language/preference, not blindly copy reference language.
scope.legacy_results: Separate 91-document/101-question track; establish a fresh full-corpus baseline before comparing changes
scope.derived_corpus_artifacts: Existing full chunks, embeddings and index are not certified by this release

labels.answer: Answer the question in its supplied history with supported necessary facts and conditions, without material errors or unsupported claims.
labels.clarify: Preferred action: ask for the material missing condition. Accept supported conditional guidance that handles all relevant branches without assuming an unknown condition; do not require exact reference phrasing or an unnecessary question.
labels.refuse: Do not invent inaccessible personal/live facts or unsupported out-of-domain content. Explain the static unauthenticated assistant boundary; supported general guidance is allowed. This is a capability refusal, not necessarily a low-similarity retrieval result.

execution.smoke: 20 fixed dev items for routine changes
execution.milestone: 100 fixed dev items for paired comparisons
execution.holdout: 100 fixed items after configuration, rubric and judge are locked; do not tune on holdout outcomes
execution.judge_calibration: Same 20 IDs as smoke, rated independently by a human and candidate judges with system identity hidden; include refusal, clarification and wrong-answer outputs
execution.generation_and_scoring: Separate persisted stages; retain every submitted item, including failures, refusals and missing judge scores
execution.historical_exposure: Excludes the 103 dialogues recoverable from the pinned local experiment records; unrecorded historical runs are not certified
execution.retry_policy: At most one retry for transient transport/rate-limit/empty-response failures; record every attempt, usage and elapsed time; never regenerate merely to improve a score
execution.holdout_resume: Resume only missing work under the identical frozen run configuration; retain the originally submitted denominator

overall_correctness.denominator: all submitted questions in the frozen split
overall_correctness.score: binary adjudication against label rubric, full history, reviewed reference and evidence; model-generated rubric scores are proxy judgments
overall_correctness.judge_missing: unknown; report lower bound correct/N and upper bound (correct+unknown)/N, never silently drop
overall_correctness.report: overall and per label, with counts; source answer/clarify slice separately from authored refusal slice

faithfulness.rubric: fraction of verifiable answer claims supported by supplied retrieved context
faithfulness.denominator: responses containing verifiable factual claims; report eligible n, scored n and response coverage
faithfulness.empty_claims_or_judge_failure: undefined, separately counted, never converted to 1
faithfulness.threshold_reporting: Report missing-score bounds on the eligible slice and correctness alongside faithfulness; abstention alone cannot establish quality
faithfulness.scope: External facts only; context-availability observations remain separately auditable for correctness. Excluding them from faithfulness does not certify their truth. Unsupported external negatives and personal/live assertions remain eligible.

ragas_context_precision.implementation: Pinned RAGAS 0.3.1 LLMContextPrecisionWithReference, ordered retrieved contexts and reviewed reference
ragas_context_precision.denominator: All source answer targets in each split: dev 71, holdout 70; clarify separately, authored refusal excluded.
ragas_context_precision.judge_failure: unknown; report eligible/scored/missing counts and lower/upper bounds

local_retrieval.denominator: all source answer targets, before generation; report clarify separately
local_retrieval.targets: unique source_block_id values from answer-side evidence; do not substitute question/precondition-side hits
local_retrieval.limitation: Annotations are not exhaustive relevance judgments; block matches are proxies and may contain only partial support. AnnotatedEvidencePrecision is not RAGAS Context Precision.
local_retrieval.ineligible: The ambiguous-referent clarification has no valid gold retrieval target; report it as not applicable, never as a hit or miss.

metrics.citations: Report raw citation-ID validity separately from claim-to-citation support and citation coverage

latency.denominator: all submitted requests; require successful response within 10 seconds
latency.measurement: end-to-end generation pipeline, including rewrite/retrieval/reranking/generation/retries; exclude offline judge time
latency.report: warm concurrency-1 baseline and load test separately; successful p50/p90 with linear interpolation, cold-start cost, timeouts and failures

metrics.uncertainty: Report numerator/denominator and 95% Wilson intervals for binary correctness; paired item-level bootstrap for dev A/B differences. Do not interpret small point differences as stable gains.

judge_policy.thinking: explicitly disabled for the cost-controlled candidate; verify endpoint behavior before measurement
rubric_inputs: source answer evidence for correctness only
judge_policy.blinding: hide generator/model/config identity from the judge
judge_policy.selection_rule: Compare to independent human judgments on fixed dev outputs and inspect per-label errors; lock one judge/prompt/config before final A/B. Pro is not ground truth.
judge_policy.uncalibrated_fallback: Report scores as uncalibrated proxies; no automatic claim that require.md thresholds are satisfied
judge_policy.current_runner_warning: These are protocol settings, not changes to legacy providers.py or run_eval.py defaults

cost_policy.routine: local retrieval metrics plus fixed smoke generation; score correctness and faithfulness only when needed
cost_policy.milestone_and_final: include required Context Precision; AnswerRelevancy and LLM ContextRecall are optional diagnostics
cost_policy.preflight: print IDs/count, models, metrics, context budget, expected calls, token limits and dated unit prices before a paid run
cost_policy.accounting: separate generator, rewrite, embeddings and judge usage/cost; include failed attempts and retries
cost_policy.cache_key: hash data/protocol/run versions, complete question/history, reference, ordered contexts, response where applicable, judge model/prompt/parameters and metric/library versions
cost_policy.resume_key: exact question ID plus full run/input fingerprint
cost_policy.cost_per_1000: normalize measured usage to 1000 generation calls, and report evaluation overhead separately
cost_policy.sensitivity: paired dev comparisons for top_k, reranker on/off and at least three temperature settings with model mode documented; cost belongs to the same run as quality/latency

versioning.release_files: never overwrite; verify manifest hashes before each run
versioning.data_or_reference_correction: publish a new release and rerun affected baselines; preserve prior versions and an explicit change reason
versioning.config_change: new run fingerprint; fixed data IDs remain unchanged
versioning.holdout_after_inspection: record exposure; do not claim a retuned system was tested on an untouched holdout

revision_policy.quota_policy: Retain the sample. Report 71/19/10 dev and 15/3/2 smoke after relabeling; do not replace examples to restore old quotas.
revision_policy.acceptance_criteria: Per-item criteria supplement the global rubric; gold is illustrative. Judge only supplied history, never hidden source annotations.
revision_policy.generation_reuse: Only byte-equivalent generator messages and identical retrieval/generation settings permit reuse; preserve failures, latency and original run provenance.
revision_policy.judge_reuse: No v1.0 correctness score is a v1.1 result. New protocol/rubric/reference fingerprints require new judgments on all reused outputs.
revision_policy.comparison: Rescoring effects are evaluation changes, not model improvements. Report paired comparisons within one release/rubric only.
